About

I'm Mohamed Abd Elhafez. I design interfaces and then build them myself, for the web, Android and iOS, so nothing gets lost between the design file and the shipped product.

A lot of my work is Arabic-first or bilingual. I treat right-to-left as a layout and interaction problem, not a translation step: navigation, alignment, icons and focus order all have to read correctly in both directions.

What I can take on

  • Interface design: flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens and small design systems.
  • Full-stack web: React and TypeScript front ends, Node.js APIs, SQL databases.
  • Mobile: Flutter for Android and iOS, SwiftUI for native iOS.
  • Arabic and English interfaces that both feel native.

Got a product to build?

Tell me what it should do and who it is for. I reply within two working days.
